reason: I already book creators on a marketplace I know, and for anyone I really want I just DM them myself. A new site with no track record, where the creators report their own numbers, isn't worth switching for this month.
objection: The follower counts and 'past results' are self-reported, so I'd be paying a fee to a platform with fewer creators and no proven history, and I'd still have to vet everyone myself the way I already do.
would_change_my_mind: Verified follower and sales data pulled straight from Instagram/TikTok, plus a bigger pool of creators in my niche than my current platform has.
